# Victoria Savitskiy — Dating Coach for Men

> Victoria Savitskiy is a private dating coach for successful, high-value men. She is Gottman-trained and a certified coach with the Coach Training Alliance. She works 1:1 and confidentially, online by video call, with a limited number of founders, executives and professionals whose dating life hasn't caught up with their career.

## What she helps with
- Men who get no dates, dates that go nowhere, or who keep dating women they don't actually want
- Her method, the Lead System, has three parts: Clarity (know exactly what you want), Read (read women accurately), Lead (lead dates and the relationship with calm confidence)
- Online dating profile and presence, where to meet women, first dates, moving from dating to commitment
- No pickup lines, no manipulation tactics

## Coaching formats
- The Reset: 4 private 1:1 sessions on one specific problem
- The Private Blueprint: 8 private 1:1 sessions, the full arc, personalised plan, feedback between sessions
- The Inner Circle: everything in the Blueprint plus priority messaging, full profile rebuild and a 30-day follow-up; limited each quarter
- Investment depends on the format and is discussed on the application call

## How to start
- Apply (2 minutes): https://victoriadatecoach.com/apply
- If it's a fit, a free private 30-minute call looks at the situation and the right coaching format; clients work with Victoria personally
